AdminCapabilities.description:
Which admin capabilities this target offers, and how writes are gated.

@ref LLP 0017#headless-admin-contract — admin-write capability is a reported
capability field, not a private flag, and unimplemented surfaces are honest
gaps rather than placeholder controls.

directDataEdit.description:
Not in this slice: direct row edits land only once they commit as ordinary
changesets with validation and live notification.

rawSql.description: Not in this slice: raw SQL is an explicit portability/safety opt-out.

tokenFile.description:
Path of the auto-minted admin token file, when the serve path
persisted one (ENG-23443). Local tooling reads the token from here:
same-user filesystem access *is* local admin (LLP 0036 D3), while a
browser page on another localhost origin cannot read files.

AppIdentity.description: Optional presentation identity for the loaded app: how the instance should introduce itself to a human. Everything here is public by construction — it is rendered on the public root page and flows into the public inspect projection — so apps must not put secrets in it. The icon/wordmark URLs are ordinary app-served or absolute URLs; the root page renders them as plain `` references with attribute escaping. @ref LLP 0017#instance-home-page — the root page renders this identity when the manifest declares it; absent, the page is Snapback-branded only.

vmLifecycle.description:
VM lifecycle for handler execution: `"fresh-per-invocation"` (the
durable default and the only hosted posture) or `"warm-pooled-reset"`
(the DK-4 trusted-local optimization — VM reuse per bundle behind a
verified per-invocation reset). Surfaced so LLP 0012's honesty rule
holds: an agent can see which execution semantics are in force.

@ref LLP 0009#dk-4-as-built--the-warm-vm-pool-and-its-per-invocation-reset-2026-07-02 — capability flag.

acquisition.description:
Structured, agent-readable acquisition metadata (LLP 0036 D6). The host
carries it verbatim to status/wizard consumers; v1 does not interpret it.

default.description:
Non-secret entries only; carried for forward compatibility. v1 rejects
non-secret entries at manifest validation, so this is always absent in
an accepted manifest.

pool.description: The entry holds an ordered pool of values rotated across invocations.

probe.description: Name of a declared action that test-calls the value (`config.verify`).

secret.description:
Default **true**: misclassification fails safe — forgetting the flag
makes a value more protected, never less (LLP 0036 D5).

CronJobDefinition.description:
@ref LLP 0028#cron-job-definition — generated function manifests carry
source-authored cron jobs beside query/mutation/action handlers.

config.description:
@ref LLP 0036#declared-configuration-in-the-manifest — declared config
entries ride the generated function manifest the way cron jobs do.

ServerInfo.description: Server-runtime facts surfaced on the admin dashboard.

storageMode.description: `"file"` or `"memory"`, derived from the storage path.

description:
The canonical admin inspect payload: the existing `InspectState` extended in
place with `server` and `admin` blocks.

@ref LLP 0017#headless-admin-contract — extend the runtime-state facts rather
than inventing a parallel schema.
